title: Simple Speedometer
description: This datapack adds a simple speedometer you can toggle with a single command.
body:
This datapack adds a **simple speedometer** _(although not customizable)_ that you can toggle with the command `/trigger show_speed`.

credits to [this awesome guy](https://www.reddit.com/r/MinecraftCommands/comments/1shuufp/comment/ofg9mnc/) for giving me the code, i suck at commands!

[A preview for the datapack, which has a small speedometer which says "Speed: 5.61 b/s" while the person who is using it is running.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39bca9ce028bec2b706e7719d71d30bc2ef178c5.png)
